purpose: Clinical research to improve prevention and health service planning.
question: Please send one anonymous count per data holder of people currently receiving an SGLT2 inhibitor; a person with several prescriptions should still contribute only once.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
SGLT2 inhibitor means ATC beginning A10BK.
A prescription is current if it started on or before 31 December 2025 and its end date is blank or on or after that date.
All ages, grouped by patients.data_holder; metric: sglt2_users.
